gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.autoStartDesc: Start Gateway when Verse Claw launches
gateway.proxyDesc: Route Electron and Gateway traffic through your local proxy client.
gateway.proxyServerHelp: The default proxy for all requests. Bare host:port values default to HTTP.
gateway.proxyHttpServerHelp: Advanced override for HTTP requests. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyHttpsServerHelp: Advanced override for HTTPS requests. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyAllServerHelp: Advanced fallback for SOCKS-capable clients and protocols such as Telegram. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyBypassHelp: Semicolon, comma, or newline separated hosts that should connect directly.
gateway.proxyRestartNote: Saving reapplies Electron networking and restarts the Gateway immediately. Regular Gateway restarts keep existing Telegram channel proxy values when proxy is disabled; save while disabled to clear them.

roleMemory.title: Role Memory
roleMemory.description: Governed role runtime memory: proposals, review, injection explain logs, retention, and quality feedback.
roleMemory.disableEffect: Turning this off stops Role Memory injection and blocks memory writes. Existing cards remain on disk and native OpenClaw memory is unchanged.

watched.description: Watch trusted local folders for new Markdown sources. New files can enter the review inbox first, and compiles refresh indexes without creating syntheses automatically.
watched.pathPlaceholder: Choose or paste a local folder path
watched.patternRequired: At least one pattern is required.

sandbox.title: Sandbox Control
sandbox.description: Verse Claw uses policy-light by default. Docker and SSH remain explicit strong-isolation providers, and missing Docker never blocks the default Gateway path.

remoteControl.title: Electron Remote Control
remoteControl.description: Expose the Electron CDP debugging port. Bind it to localhost and use it only in trusted environments. Restart Verse Claw after saving.
